# ASCEND

> Free, open-source gym & body-weight tracker (AGPL-3.0). Evolve beyond your limits.
> Runs as a standalone Android app (sideloaded APK), on iPhone through the self-hosted
> web app (PWA), or self-hosted with Docker (passkey profiles, multi-device sync, PWA).
> No account required, no cloud, no telemetry. The production site is opengym.ch; the
> app is ASCEND.

## Docs
- [Complete reference](https://opengym.ch/docs.html): every feature, self-hosting, every .env setting, AI Coach, imports (FitNotes/Strong/Hevy/Apple Health), backups, MCP server, troubleshooting
- [HTTP API](https://opengym.ch/api.html): OpenAPI spec, also at [openapi.yaml](https://opengym.ch/openapi.yaml)
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jrsmDev/ASCEND/main/README.md): project overview in Markdown
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/jrsmDev/ASCEND/blob/main/docs/README.md): every guide by audience, plus an [FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jrsmDev/ASCEND/main/docs/FAQ.md)

## Try & get it
- [Live demo](https://opengym.ch/demo/): the real app with example data, in the browser
- [Android APK](https://opengym.ch/#download): the signed Standard build (180 px animations) direct from the site with its SHA-256; the older Plus (240 px) and HD (360 px) packs remain on the upstream openGym release and use a different signing key
- [About](https://opengym.ch/about.html): the story and every release

## How it is built
- ASCEND is a rebrand of openGym, whose codebase was developed with Claude Code. ASCEND changes are reviewed, tested and released by the maintainer. The app itself needs no AI service; the AI coach and MCP server are optional.

## Source & community
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/jrsmDev/ASCEND): code, issues, pull requests, releases
- [Upstream openGym](https://github.com/DuarteSantos8/openGym): the original project and its [GitLab CI mirror](https://gitlab.com/DuarteSantos8/opengym)
- [Discord](https://discord.gg/e62jY6fwVb): openGym release announcements and self-hosting help
